description: This file defines a custom assertion class for JsonPointer objects, providing assertion methods to verify properties like level count, emptiness, key containment, root, and leaf of a JSON pointer.

classes.name: JsonPointerAssert
classes.description: A custom AssertJ assertion class for JsonPointer objects, offering fluent assertion methods for common checks.

methods.name: hasLevelCount
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonPointer has the specified number of levels.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonPointer is empty.

methods.name: isNotEmpty
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonPointer is not empty.

methods.name: isEqualTo
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonPointer is equal to another object.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonPointer contains specified key(s).

methods.name: doesNotContainKey
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonPointer does not contain specified key(s).

methods.name: hasRoot
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonPointer has the specified root key.

methods.name: hasLeaf
methods.description: Asserts that the JsonPointer has the specified leaf key.
